/-! Hole `h_25` of a merged partial proof, as a node (D-12 #5, D-29).

theorem variant_3969f1f7__h2__h1__h1__h3 : ∀ (n m : ℕ),
  (4 : ℕ) ≤ n →
    (10 : ℕ) ≤ m → n.choose (2 : ℕ) = m.choose (5 : ℕ) → n = (78 : ℕ) ∧ m = (15 : ℕ) ∨ n = (153 : ℕ) ∧ m = (19 : ℕ) := by

theorem witness : ∃ (n : ℕ) (m : ℕ), (4 : ℕ) ≤ n ∧ (10 : ℕ) ≤ m ∧ n.choose 2 = m.choose 5 :=
  ⟨78, 15, by norm_num, by norm_num, by
    rw [Nat.choose_eq_factorial_div_factorial (by norm_num), Nat.choose_eq_factorial_div_factorial (by norm_num)]
    norm_num [Nat.factorial]⟩
